hardware: Two RTX 3090 GPUs, 24 GB each; 128 GB host RAM
method: Fresh QLoRA SFT; completion-only loss; source-separated training and evaluation
review: 80 scenarios audited and independently cross-reviewed by Astra High. Answers judged by the primary assistant with model identity hidden until each split was graded; no human calibration and not a fresh independent reference-blind judge.
limits: One generation per case, one sampling seed.
Four held-out source families; cases are correlated.
Writer-only evaluation on curated context, not live audio or full copilot quality.
Shorter outputs explain much of the latency change; no throughput improvement established.
decision: No clear held-out storytelling improvement. Retained as experimental; subsequently enabled for an explicit user-requested private interactive trial.
